caveats: Current ground-truthing data highlights a true positive rate of *92%* (some high schools, warehouses and religious infrastructure are wrongly categorized as primary schools), and an estimated false negative rate of *12%* (community and religious school infrastructure sometimes has unrecognizable shape).
methodology_other: This data was collected as a combination of *satellite detection* and *on-the-ground verification*.
name: cote-d-ivoire-primary-schools
notes:
This dataset contains geolocations of **Côte d'Ivoire's primary schools** as identified by **Enveritas' satellite detection algorithm** in July 2019. Enveritas updates this dataset with on-the-ground observations, which consist of field agents going to the identified locations and confirming the presence of primary schools. The last update dates back from April 2021.
For more information on the methodology, do not hesitate to [contact us](https://enveritas.org/).

organization.description:
[Enveritas](https://enveritas.org) is a US-based non-profit founded in 2016 to overcome systemic barriers that prevent the application of proven solutions for ending poverty among smallholder coffee and cocoa growers.
Enveritas has developed a new methodology that combines **geospatial data processing** with **on-the-ground observations** to offer assurance and insights on a wide panel of topics, such as farm sustainability, deforestation, and quality of education.
Enveritas currently works for private companies as well as governments and foundations, and operates in most major cocoa and coffee origins in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.
